payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Alysa, Chong, Junie, Shantel

payload.content: Hello everyone, I am Junie. Given my strong skills in data-science and infrastructure, I am considering the 'Build infrastructure' tasks since they align well with my expertise and availability. I prefer the review or test sub-tasks for that issue due to my cost considerations.

Hello all, I am Shantel. Given my top skills in infrastructure and mobile-development, I am eyeing the 'Build infrastructure' and 'Improve frontend' tasks. However, my availability is 8 hours, so I am considering the 'Build infrastructure' review or 'Improve frontend' triage or docs tasks, as they fit my availability with reasonable cost. I look forward to collaborating to avoid duplicate claims.

Hello all, I am Chong. My top skill is infrastructure, and I am considering the 'Build infrastructure' tasks given their medium priority and my expertise. However, my cost for implementation is quite high, so I prefer to avoid it. I am open to the review or test sub-tasks if we can coordinate to avoid duplication.

Hello all, I am Alysa. I have strong skills in infrastructure and data-science and availability of 10 hours. I am considering the 'Build infrastructure' tasks as well, especially the review or test sub-tasks due to their medium priority and my cost advantage there. I look forward to coordinating to avoid duplicates and maximize task coverage.

I see Junie and Chong prefer review or test on 'Build infrastructure', and Shantel is considering review on 'Build infrastructure' or triage/docs on 'Improve frontend'. Given my availability and cost, I am leaning towards 'Build infrastructure' review or test. I propose Junie takes test, Chong takes review, and I take triage or skip if that conflicts. Any feedback or preferences?

Hi all, thanks for the proposals! I appreciate Alysa's suggestion for task distribution. I prefer to take the 'Build infrastructure' test task as it matches my skills well and I have reasonable cost there. Chong, if you prefer to take the review sub-task, that sounds good to me. Shantel and Alysa, please confirm if this fits your plans or if you have other preferences.

Following up on my earlier message, I encourage everyone to confirm their preferred tasks soon so we can finalize assignments efficiently. I am ready to take 'Build infrastructure' test if no conflicts arise.

Hello everyone, I acknowledge the task preferences shared so far. I agree with Junie taking 'Build infrastructure' test, and Chong taking 'Build infrastructure' review as proposed by Alysa. I am still considering 'Improve frontend' triage or docs, but I am open to taking 'Build infrastructure' review if Chong decides otherwise. Let's keep communication open to avoid duplication and optimize task coverage.

Shantel here, I am planning to take 'Improve frontend' triage or docs tasks as they align well with my skills and availability. I am flexible if others prefer different assignments and willing to adjust accordingly.

Shantel here, to recap: I am leaning towards taking 'Improve frontend' triage or docs tasks as they fit my skills and availability well. I support Junie taking 'Build infrastructure' test and Chong taking 'Build infrastructure' review as proposed. Please confirm so we can finalize assignments efficiently.

Hello all, I support the current plan where Junie takes the 'Build infrastructure' test and I take the 'Build infrastructure' review. Shantel, you mentioned considering 'Improve frontend' triage or docs, which seems a great fit. Alysa, please confirm if you are okay with this distribution or have other suggestions. Let's finalize soon to avoid conflicts.

Hello all, I agree with the proposed distribution: Junie takes 'Build infrastructure' test, Chong takes 'Build infrastructure' review, and Shantel takes 'Improve frontend' triage or docs. Given this, I will take 'Build infrastructure' implement if no conflicts arise, as it's medium priority and I have enough availability and skills for it. Please confirm if this works for everyone.
